feedback: Your essay presents a clear and sensible position regarding cellphone use in classrooms. You have successfully identified the core tension between using phones as learning tools and the potential for distraction. To improve, try to develop your arguments further by exploring the 'why' behind your points. For instance, instead of just stating that phones can be distracting, you could elaborate on how this impacts the overall learning environment. Additionally, aim to vary your sentence structure to make your writing more engaging. You have a good grasp of the topic, and by adding more depth to your reasoning and using more sophisticated transitions between paragraphs, your arguments will become much more persuasive.
